title: D2C E-Commerce Operations & Growth Director
description: Lead direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce strategy, retail merchandising, marketplace scaling, and digital customer acquisition.
details:
### Role Overview
Lead omnichannel retail expansion, e-commerce platform operations, and D2C customer growth for fast-growing retail brands.

### Key Responsibilities
- Drive revenue growth across online storefronts, Amazon/Flipkart marketplaces, and physical retail stores.
- Optimize digital merchandising, catalog management, cart conversions, and customer lifetime value (CLV).
- Partner with supply chain and fulfillment teams for seamless last-mile order delivery.

### Requirements
- Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or E-Commerce Management.
- 6+ years in D2C e-commerce operations, retail scaling, or marketplace growth.
